parties.petitioner: Director General, Doordarshan Prasar Bharti Corporation of India & Anr.

summary: Pension qualification period: casual/contractual service vs temporary service; Rule 13 of Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 1972 interpreted; temporary service requires uninterrupted transition to substantive appointment; contractual service doesn't qualify as temporary service; High Court error in conflating casual/contractual with temporary status; no provision for counting pre-regularization contractual period; scheme/scheme clarification (2009 DOPT) excludes contractual service benefits; appeal allowed based on rule interpretation.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; contractual service period not counted for pension benefits.
